department: Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering (Smith Engineering)

deadline.value: No hard deadline, but apply before March 1 to improve your chances of internal awards.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: There is no hard deadline; however, we encourage you to apply before March 1 to improve your odds of qualifying for internal awards.

gre_general.value: The department does not use the GRE; do not submit scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering (MME) does not use Graduate Record Examination (GRE) to assess applications.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department lists TOEFL iBT 88/120 (old scale) with Writing 24, Speaking 22, Reading 22, Listening 20.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT minimum scores of: writing (24/30); speaking (22/30); reading (22/30); listening (20/30), for a total of 88/120

supervisor.value: Identify and contact potential supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to identify an area of research interest and contact potential supervisor(s) before applying.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students receive TA/RA and/or Queen's Graduate Award support, minimum CAD 27,000 a year.
funding.quote: Graduate students admitted to a PhD program are provided financial support in the form of a teaching and research assistantship and/or Queen's Graduate Award. | PhD funding: minimum $27,000 per year.

entry_route.value: A MASc or MEng is required.
entry_route.quote: Master’s degree in Applied Science (MASc) or Engineering (MEng)

notes: Offers for September usually end of March to July.
